name: @kitora/maps
description: Kitora's maps and location kit: a framework-free geo core (bounds, distance, clustering, routes, a geocoder adapter, an autocomplete state machine), a MapLibre engine seam, React parts (map, markers, popups, clusters, routes) and styled presets (location picker, address autocomplete). Each layer is its own entry (`/core`, `/dom`, `/react`, `/ui`), plus opt-in `/samples` data. No API keys.

pasted "lat, lng" answered as a coordinate result, reverse = nearest place

parts.name: Popup
parts.description:
A floating panel over a point. It is an overlay-kit `AnchoredPopover` (one entry on
the shared overlay stack: Escape goes to the top entry only, focus returns
along the opener chain, it nests under any dialog it opens in), anchored to
a zero-size engine marker at `lngLat`. Its positioner follows the marker on
every frame of a pan or zoom and hides the popup while its point is outside
the map. Only the bare map closes it on a
click (a click on a marker selects that marker instead), so the overlay's own
outside-press dismissal is off. The anchor-only path renders no Base UI focus guards, and by
default the popup does not take focus.

props.name: lngLat
props.description: The point the popup stands over.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called on Escape, on the close button a preset renders, and on a click on the bare map.

props.name: closeOnMapClick
props.description: Whether a click on the bare map closes the popup.

props.name: offset
props.description: Gap in px between the point and the popup's bottom edge (clear the pin).

props.name: label
props.description: The popup's accessible name (the overlay entry's `name`).

props.name: positioner
props.description:
How the popup is kept against its point. The default follows the marker every frame of a pan
or zoom; any overlay-kit `Positioner` can replace it.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the overlay popup panel; they merge over the overlay kit's popover chrome.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description:
Where focus goes when the popup opens (the overlay kit's `PopoverInitialFocus`). With `false`
a map popup leaves focus where it is, so one that opens at load neither steals focus nor
scrolls the page. `true` moves focus into the popup (its close button first).

props.description: The popup's content.

the shared overlay stack: Escape goes to the top entry only, focus returns
along the opener chain, it nests under any dialog it opens in), anchored to

default the popup does not take focus.
